question: Tell me top10 teams with the most wins across the league
sql:
WITH home_wins AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) as wins
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
),
away_wins AS (
    SELECT away_team_api_id, COUNT(*) as wins
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name as team_name, CAST(SUM(w.wins) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
FROM (
    SELECT home_team_api_id as team_api_id, wins FROM home_wins
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team_api_id as team_api_id, wins FROM away_wins
) w
JOIN Team t ON w.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10
